field.label: Suricata reporter enabled
field.help: Report attacker IPs seen in Suricata IDS/IPS alerts to AbuseIPDB, in addition to the firewall-log reporter. Requires Suricata EVE JSON logging (Services: Intrusion Detection: Administration: enable "EVE"). Submit-safety options (dry-run, pre-check, per-IP rate limit, daily quota) are shared with the Reporter tab.

field.label: EVE log path
field.help: Absolute path to the Suricata EVE JSON log. Default /var/log/suricata/eve.json — change only if you moved it.

field.label: Minimum alert priority
field.help: Lowest Suricata priority level to include: 1 = high only, 2 = high + medium (default), 3 = everything (also low-severity/policy rules — noisy). An alert is kept when its severity number is at most this value.

field.label: Minimum alerts before report
field.help: Number of alerts from an IP within one run before it is reported. 1 = report on the first alert. Raise to suppress single, isolated hits.

field.label: Fallback categories
field.help: Comma-separated AbuseIPDB category IDs used when an alert's Suricata classtype can't be mapped automatically. Known classtypes map on their own (scan→14, web attack→21, brute force→18, SQLi→16, trojan→15+20, …). 15=Hacking is a safe default.

field.label: Comment template
field.help: Text submitted as the report comment. Placeholders: {count}, {signatures}, {categories}, {ports}, {protos}, {iface}, {src_ip}. Max 1000 chars after substitution (API limit 1024).
